title: AEP advisory evidence export
scope: Read-only AEP-compatible source evidence export from the current AEGS handoff and takeover gate
alternatives: Require consumers to inspect internal governance files or claim automatic takeover
impact: External consumers receive advisory-only, no-auto-takeover evidence
counter_evidence: The export cannot prove consumer behavior, freshness after emission, or grant cross-project permission
acceptance_criteria: Exports required AEP fields with timezone, stable summary, and actual non-PASS takeover status
rollback_reference: Revert the AEP evidence export commit; keep internal governance evidence and handoff checks unchanged.
